netflix.title: AlMahaitiya
netflix.overview: A wealthy family loses their fortune and chooses to continue to fake affluence in an effort to keep up appearances.

amazon-prime-video.title: I Would Rather Die
amazon-prime-video.overview: The protagonist Archie, considered the school loser, is bitten by a zombie and finds himself at the center of a mission to save the city alongside his friends Cris and Brenda.

amazon-prime-video.title: Honor Thy Mother
amazon-prime-video.overview: After years of estrangement, a mother and daughter find themselves on opposite sides of a bitter contest for what each believes is rightfully hers. Old wounds resurface as they weigh whether to confront the past together or let it drive them further apart.

apple-tv.title: The Last First: Winter K2
apple-tv.overview: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

apple-tv.title: Brothers
apple-tv.overview: Matthew and Woody have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

apple-tv.title: Last Seen
apple-tv.overview: Police dispatcher Ian Ridley's daughter Maggie disappeared years ago. He receives a call, believing it's her, and embarks on a relentless quest to find her and reunite his family, disregarding consequences.

disney-plus.title: Coven Academy
disney-plus.overview: In the haunted heart of New Orleans, three teenage witches and their warlock peers attend an elite magic boarding school where power is currency, secrets are lethal and attraction is a liability.

skyshowtime.title: Deadly Ties
skyshowtime.overview: A continuation of the *Śleboda* series, centering on anthropologist Anka Serafin and journalist Sebastian Strzygoń. This time, the story takes us to Upper Silesia.

hayu.title: Still Flipping Out
hayu.overview: Follows Lewis as he navigates the hilariously unpredictable nature of his professional and personal lives as his trademark spontaneity collides with the people who work with him, for him, and still somehow survive him.

hbo-max.title: A Killer Story
hbo-max.overview: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

mubi.title: JAŸ-Z in 8
mubi.overview: Thirty years after his landmark debut album, artist, icon, philanthropist, and entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career.

mubi.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
mubi.overview: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

bloodstream.title: She Did It
bloodstream.overview: After a suicide attempt, a fragile young woman awakens to find her boyfriend claiming her dead body is in their bathtub.

bloodstream.title: Creature Fear
bloodstream.overview: In a small Wisconsin lake town, a poverty-stricken felon contracts Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease after ingesting diseased venison. As his descent into madness intensifies, he targets a Chicago musician and a mysterious singer, whose dream of recording an album together is threatened by the felon's violent unraveling.

bloodstream.title: V/C/R/01

kableone.title: Mitti de Putt
kableone.overview: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away.

crunchyroll-amazon-channel.title: From Far Away
crunchyroll-amazon-channel.overview: On her way home from school one day, Noriko is unexpectedly plunged into a strange and extraordinary fantasy world. Her troubles compound exponentially when she is rescued and befriended by a handsome young man by the name of Izark. He may be brave and courageous, but inside Izark lurks the darkest evil imaginable. And according to an ancient prophecy, Noriko possesses the power to unleash that evil. Now, inexorably bound together, these two unlikely allies must navigate a world both wondrous and hostile.
